lines.zh: 我沿着树冠边缘走，尾巴先探路。
lines.en: I walk the canopy edge, tail scouting first.

lines.zh: 白天我是小猴，夜里我踩断树枝。
lines.en: By day a small monkey; by night I snap branches.

lines.zh: 山魁的脚步很轻，落叶不会出卖我。
lines.en: A howler's steps are light; fallen leaves never betray me.

lines.zh: 我带着整群小猴穿过雨林。
lines.en: I lead the whole troop of little monkeys through the rainforest.

lines.zh: 镰刀尾拖在身后，划开低垂的藤。
lines.en: My scythe tail drags behind, slicing the hanging vines.

lines.zh: 月光把我的斑纹照得更深。
lines.en: Moonlight deepens the stripes along my back.

lines.zh: 四足落地，我比看上去更沉。
lines.en: On four limbs I land heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 树根间有条旧路，只有我们记得。
lines.en: An old path between roots only my troop remembers.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我从上面经过。
lines.en: Do not look up; I am passing overhead.

lines.zh: 尾巴绷紧时，树林会先安静。
lines.en: When my tail tightens, the forest goes quiet first.

lines.zh: 我沿树干绕行，爪子抠进树皮。
lines.en: I circle the trunk, claws digging into bark.

lines.zh: 夜风送我气味，我知道谁在下方。
lines.en: Night wind carries scent; I know who walks below.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枝头，数着雨滴。
lines.en: I crouch on a branch, counting raindrops.

lines.zh: 诅咒在黄昏后收紧我的骨头。
lines.en: The curse tightens my bones after dusk.

lines.zh: 猴群睡在树洞里，由我守着。
lines.en: The troop sleeps in a hollow; I keep watch.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴卷住树干打盹。
lines.en: I doze with my tail coiled around the trunk.

lines.zh: 斑纹在暗处像裂开的树影。
lines.en: My stripes look like split shadows in the dark.

lines.zh: 我在等月亮换一个形状。
lines.en: I wait for the moon to change its shape.

lines.zh: 爪子上还留着上一场的树汁。
lines.en: Tree sap from the last hunt still stains my claws.

lines.zh: 林子里没有风，我照样闻到血味。
lines.en: Windless woods, yet I still smell blood.

lines.zh: 我舔着镰刀尾的弯口。
lines.en: I lick the curve of my scythe tail.

lines.zh: 远处的火把让我眯起眼。
lines.en: Distant torches make me narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我记得每根能承重的藤。
lines.en: I remember every vine that holds weight.

lines.zh: 小猴在梦里叫，我应了一声。
lines.en: A little one calls in sleep; I answer once.

lines.zh: 雨林太吵，我反而听得清。
lines.en: The rainforest is loud, so I hear clearly.

lines.zh: 今晚的月色适合留下爪子。
lines.en: Tonight's moonlight suits leaving a claw behind.

lines.zh: 我把爪子搭在枝上，歇一歇。
lines.en: I hook my claws on the branch and rest.

lines.zh: 猴群在树下睡着，我不睡。
lines.en: The troop sleeps below; I don't.

lines.zh: 月亮偏了一点，我该动了。
lines.en: The moon has shifted. Time to move.

lines.zh: 尾巴上的弯钩，我磨得很利。
lines.en: The hook on my tail is honed sharp.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在我跳程内。
lines.en: You stand exactly within my leaping range.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为你太像猎物。
lines.en: I tilt my head because you look like prey.

lines.zh: 你身上没有猴群的气味。
lines.en: You carry no scent of my troop.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的喉咙，不是礼貌。
lines.en: I stare at your throat; it is not politeness.

lines.zh: 别把手伸向树枝，那是我的。
lines.en: Do not reach for that branch; it is mine.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我看不清你的眼睛。
lines.en: Your torch blinds me to your eyes.

lines.zh: 我在算你退到树后的步数。
lines.en: I am counting the steps until you reach that tree.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我就赢了。
lines.en: If you look up to find me, I have won.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁，你带着武器。
lines.en: I smell iron on you; you came armed.

lines.zh: 山魁看人，先看影子。
lines.en: A howler reads your shadow before your face.

lines.zh: 你脚步太重，猴群已经散了。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy; the troop has scattered.

lines.zh: 我瞳孔缩成一条，你该懂了。
lines.en: My pupils narrow to slits; you should understand.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起白天挨的石子。
lines.en: This blow recalls the stones thrown at me by day.

lines.zh: 你打得中我，说明你抬头了。
lines.en: You hit me, so you finally looked up.

lines.zh: 血味让我更清醒，不是更怕。
lines.en: The smell of blood sharpens me, not frightens me.

lines.zh: 尾巴缩了一下，只是本能。
lines.en: My tail flinched; that was only instinct.

lines.zh: 我退到树上，不是逃。
lines.en: I retreat into the tree; it is not flight.

lines.zh: 这伤会跟着月亮好起来。
lines.en: This wound will heal with the moon.

lines.zh: 猴群在叫，我让它们别过来。
lines.en: The troop cries; I tell them to stay back.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是斑纹，不是我。
lines.en: You struck the stripes, not me.

lines.zh: 疼让我记起自己还有身体。
lines.en: Pain reminds me I still have a body.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我会换个角度落。
lines.en: Again, and I will land from another angle.

lines.zh: 香蕉递过来，我只想起猴群。
lines.en: Offer a banana and I only think of my troop.

lines.zh: 你摇果实，我的尾巴先动了。
lines.en: Shake fruit and my tail moves before I decide.

lines.zh: 白天我会接，现在不会。
lines.en: By daylight I would take it; not now.

lines.zh: 甜味让我记起自己曾是小的。
lines.en: Sweetness reminds me I was once small.

lines.zh: 我不吃素，但记得果皮的味道。
lines.en: I eat no plants, yet recall the taste of peel.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高一点，我够得到。
lines.en: Lift that meat higher; I can reach it.

lines.zh: 猴群在叫，那比食物更管用。
lines.en: The troop is calling; that works better than food.

lines.zh: 我靠近不是接受，是在量距离。
lines.en: I come closer not to accept, but to measure.

lines.zh: 月光下递来的东西，我一律怀疑。
lines.en: Anything offered under moonlight I distrust.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，先放下再退开。
lines.en: Put it down and step back first.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会先闻到树皮味。
lines.en: Bump into me and you will smell bark first.

lines.zh: 我的肩比看上去硬，别试。
lines.en: My shoulder is harder than it looks; do not test it.

lines.zh: 尾巴被你碰了，这下不算好意。
lines.en: You touched my tail; this is no longer friendly.

lines.zh: 我撞开你，只是不想绕路。
lines.en: I shove you aside only to avoid a detour.

lines.zh: 树冠狭窄，让开一点。
lines.en: The canopy is narrow; give me room.

lines.zh: 我用肩提醒你，别再靠近。
lines.en: My shoulder is a reminder to keep your distance.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹擦过你的盔甲。
lines.en: My stripes brush against your armor.

lines.zh: 你挡住藤蔓，我只能挤过去。
lines.en: You block the vine; I can only squeeze past.

lines.zh: 猴群跟在后面，别踩它们。
lines.en: The troop follows behind; do not step on them.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就用尾巴。
lines.en: Bump me again and the tail comes out.

lines.zh: 猴群里没有谁愿意靠近我。
lines.en: No one in the troop dares come close to me.

lines.zh: 诅咒把这件事从我身上拿走了。
lines.en: The curse took this from me long ago.

lines.zh: 我只在月圆时想起自己有过伴。
lines.en: Only at full moon do I recall having a mate.

lines.zh: 小猴不是我生的，但我带着它们。
lines.en: The little ones are not mine, yet I lead them.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴会伤人，不适合靠太近。
lines.en: My tail wounds; it is unfit for closeness.

lines.zh: 雨林的夜里，叫声比触碰可靠。
lines.en: In rainforest nights, calls are surer than touch.

lines.zh: 我守着树洞，那就算我的家。
lines.en: I guard the hollow; that counts as home.

lines.zh: 别替我找伴，先找块安静的树冠。
lines.en: Do not find me a mate; find a quiet canopy.

lines.zh: 斑纹越深，越没有谁愿意留下。
lines.en: The deeper my stripes, the fewer who stay.

lines.zh: 我把这事交给月光处理。
lines.en: I leave this matter to the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只抓会动的。
lines.en: I pick nothing up; I only grab what moves.

lines.zh: 地上的果子留给小猴。
lines.en: Fruit on the ground is for the little ones.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物，我看一眼就走。
lines.en: I glance at your dropped item and leave.

lines.zh: 爪子用来抓，不用来拿。
lines.en: Claws are for seizing, not for carrying.

lines.zh: 我把它拨到树下，谁要谁捡。
lines.en: I flick it under the tree; whoever wants it can have it.

lines.zh: 这亮东西会响，我不碰。
lines.en: This shiny thing rattles; I will not touch it.

lines.zh: 猴群会来收，我不操心。
lines.en: The troop will collect it; not my concern.

lines.zh: 我叼走过猎物，没叼过行李。
lines.en: I have carried prey, never luggage.

lines.zh: 捡起它就得放下尾巴的架势。
lines.en: Picking it up means dropping my tail's stance.

lines.zh: 留下吧，雨林会处理。
lines.en: Leave it; the rainforest will deal with it.

lines.zh: 你踏进树冠下的暗处，我选中你。
lines.en: You stepped into the shade below; I choose you.

lines.zh: 猴子们安静了，说明目标定了。
lines.en: The monkeys fell silent; the target is set.

lines.zh: 我闻到汗，猎物跑不远。
lines.en: I smell sweat; prey never runs far.

lines.zh: 你背对藤蔓，这是最差的位置。
lines.en: Your back is to the vines; the worst spot.

lines.zh: 尾巴已经指向你，别再假装路过。
lines.en: My tail points at you; stop pretending to pass by.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你落了单。
lines.en: I choose you because you are alone.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，替我标好了位置。
lines.en: The branch you snapped marked your place for me.

lines.zh: 火把照不到我，但照得到你。
lines.en: The torch misses me and finds you.

lines.zh: 我记住你的气味了，跑吧。
lines.en: I have your scent now; run.

lines.zh: 这一群猴子里，我最先看见你。
lines.en: Of this whole troop, I saw you first.

lines.zh: 你带了铁，那更好，声音会暴露你。
lines.en: You brought iron; good, it will announce you.

lines.zh: 目标不换，直到你倒下或消失。
lines.en: The target stays until you fall or vanish.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一步不多。
lines.en: I follow you, not one step more.

lines.zh: 你听见树叶响，那是尾巴。
lines.en: You heard leaves move; that was the tail.

lines.zh: 我在等一个你抬头的瞬间。
lines.en: I wait for the moment you look up.

lines.zh: 你走得越急，我越不着急。
lines.en: The faster you walk, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 我换到另一棵树，你还没发现。
lines.en: I move to another tree; you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越快，我数得清。
lines.en: Your panting quickens, and I count every breath.

lines.zh: 猴群在你身后学我叫。
lines.en: Behind you the troop mimics my call.

lines.zh: 我数到三就下来。
lines.en: I will come down when I reach three.

lines.zh: 月光把我们的影子叠在一起。
lines.en: Moonlight lays our shadows on top of each other.

lines.zh: 你回头看的方向，总是错的。
lines.en: The direction you check is always wrong.

lines.zh: 别停下，停下我就落地。
lines.en: Do not stop; if you stop, I land.

lines.zh: 尾巴在你头顶画了个圈。
lines.en: My tail drew a circle above your head.

lines.zh: 镰刀尾扫过，你该退半步。
lines.en: The scythe tail sweeps; you should have stepped back.

lines.zh: 我扑下来，爪子先到。
lines.en: I drop down; the claws arrive first.

lines.zh: 这一尾巴专治转身逃跑。
lines.en: This tail is made for those who turn and run.

lines.zh: 斑纹一晃，你就慢了半拍。
lines.en: My stripes flicker and you lose half a beat.

lines.zh: 我咬住肩，再借树荡开。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder, then swing away on a branch.

lines.zh: 尾巴勾住你的腿，别挣。
lines.en: The tail hooks your leg; do not struggle.

lines.zh: 猴群的叫声盖住了我落地。
lines.en: The troop's cries covered my landing.

lines.zh: 我从背后下手，因为正面太亮。
lines.en: I strike from behind; the front is too bright.

lines.zh: 爪子留了印，你会记得我。
lines.en: The claws leave a mark; you will remember me.

lines.zh: 下一次，尾巴会从另一侧来。
lines.en: Next time the tail comes from the other side.

lines.zh: 夜幕落下，我从猴形里挣出来。
lines.en: Night falls and I tear free of monkey shape.

lines.zh: 树冠深处传来一声长嚎。
lines.en: A long howl rises from deep in the canopy.

lines.zh: 月光照到斑纹，我就醒了。
lines.en: Moonlight touches my stripes and I wake.

lines.zh: 猴群让开一条路，我走出来。
lines.en: The troop parts; I step through.

lines.zh: 雨林的湿气托着我落地。
lines.en: Rainforest damp carries me down to the ground.

lines.zh: 这棵树记得我的爪子。
lines.en: This tree remembers my claws.

lines.zh: 诅咒又在黄昏准时收紧。
lines.en: The curse tightens on schedule at dusk.

lines.zh: 我带着整群小猴巡夜。
lines.en: I patrol the night with my troop of little monkeys.

lines.zh: 尾巴先醒，我随后。
lines.en: The tail wakes first; I follow.

lines.zh: 有人闯进了我的树冠。
lines.en: Someone has entered my canopy.

lines.zh: 山魁的名字，是猴群替我喊的。
lines.en: The troop gave me the name Howler.

lines.zh: 从树洞里出来，我比昨天更饿。
lines.en: Out of the hollow, hungrier than yesterday.

lines.zh: 火烧到毛，我闻到的却是树皮。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur; I smell bark instead.

lines.zh: 从这么高的树摔下，我该更小心。
lines.en: Falling from such a height, I should be more careful.

lines.zh: 雨林的河不深，可我不擅长游。
lines.en: The rainforest river is shallow, but I swim poorly.

lines.zh: 炸开的土盖住了我的斑纹。
lines.en: Blasted soil buries my stripes.

lines.zh: 箭从下方来，这回你学乖了。
lines.en: The arrow came from below; you learned.

lines.zh: 咒语缠上来，和我身上那道很像。
lines.en: This spell coils like the curse already on me.

lines.zh: 饿到眼花，我连影子都想扑。
lines.en: Starving, I would pounce on my own shadow.

lines.zh: 雷打中树，我跟着抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree; I shuddered with it.

lines.zh: 掉出世界时，我还在找树枝。
lines.en: Falling out of the world, I still reach for a branch.
